title: rosa gallica proles rubra
intro: Rosa gallica proles rubra, commonly known as the Red Damask rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is used in herbal medicine due to its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Rosa gallica proles rubra include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
